scope: Apple M3 Max FP32 fixed-720p ncnn Vulkan versus tch MPS short-clip screening only

conversion.graph: 18 Convolution, 17 PReLU, PixelShuffle 4x CRD, Interp 4x nearest-neighbor residual

backend.ncnn: official 20260526 C API generated by bindgen 0.73.2; MoltenVK 1.4.2 on Apple M3 Max; use_vulkan_compute=1 with fp16/int8 options disabled
backend.binding_note: No actively maintained ncnn-specific Rust binding with complete Vulkan FP32 controls found; ncnnrs last published in 2024 and its repository was unavailable. This experiment binds the supported official C API instead.

serial_after_warmup.timing_boundary: total_ms includes PNG load, input preparation/transfer, full synchronized 4x output readback. Inner API timings have different input transfer boundaries and are not a kernel-speed comparison.

media: Both candidates output 120 HEVC lossless 2560x1440 frames at 24000/1001 fps and PCM 44100Hz stereo audio (5.005s); SHA256 is identical between each backend's two runs
resource: ncnn peak footprint about 2.70GB, tch about 2.45GB; pmset -g therm reported no thermal/performance warning at the checks; numeric chip temperature was unavailable
limits: Only two valid 5-second paired runs; no main 3-minute confidence lower bound and no full-video validation
Only fixed 1280x720 model conversion tested; no dynamic-resolution claim
MoltenVK is Vulkan over Metal, not a native ncnn Metal execution provider
The historical Apple M3 migration decision remains pending
